messages.content: i have a new neighbor and do not know how to start talking to her.
a simple hello is enough to start. you could say: hello. i live next door and would like to say welcome.
should i ask her to come for tea right away?
you can if you would like to, but you do not have to. you can start with hello and see if she has time to talk.
she has many boxes to carry.
then keep it short. you could say hello and ask if she would like help carrying a box.
just give me the words to say to her.
hello. welcome to the street. would you like some help with your boxes?
i read a page today after not reading for a while.
that is a good start. how did it feel to read again?
a little hard, but it was nice to sit with the book.
then there was a part you could enjoy even while it felt hard. you can take your time with the next page too.
i do not want a reading plan. i just want to tell you about my day.
thank you for telling me. i am happy you had some time with your book.
keep it simple.
it is nice that you had some time with your book today.
my friend would like to meet at the park or the library. i need a quiet place to read with her.
the library may be a good place if you both want to read in a quiet room.
use only our words. the library is closed today.
then you cannot meet inside the library today. is there a quiet place at the park where you could read?
yes, under a tree away from the game area.
that may work if the weather is good. you could meet under that tree and bring your books.
write the plan in one sentence.
let us meet under the tree away from the game area at the park and bring our books.
write a note to my teacher saying i started the work but did not finish.
i started the work, but i have not finished it. could i have more time to finish, please?
i do not want to say i did not remember. i did remember.
you do not have to say that. the note can just say you started and need more time.
add that i can bring it tomorrow.
i started the work, but i have not finished it. could i bring it tomorrow, please?
should i say i finished if i think i will finish later today?
no. say what is true now. you can say you hope to finish it later today.
i always choose the same chair at home. is that okay?
yes. you can have a chair you like. maybe you enjoy its light, its place in the room, or how it feels.
i like that i can see the garden.
then you like that you can sit in that chair and see the garden.
i also keep my book near that chair.
that gives you a place to sit and read, with your book already near you.
yes. i do not need a big reason.
no. you can enjoy that little part of your day just as it is.
tell me a quiet story about a woman making a meal for her own evening at home.

a woman came home with bread, a tomato, and some cheese. she put them on the table and opened the window. there was no need to make a large meal, so she chose a plate and cut the tomato. she put the bread and cheese next to it, then made a cup of tea. before sitting down, she moved a book from the chair to the table. the room was quiet, and the food was simple. she ate a little, read a page, and looked outside. after dinner, she washed the plate and cup. then she closed the window and sat with her book again.
did she cook a meal for a large family?
no. she made a simple meal for her own evening at home.
what did she do after washing the plate and cup?
she closed the window and sat with her book again.
make this shorter: my sister is coming to the house, but she is not here at the house now.
my sister is coming, but she is not here now.
make it sound like i am answering someone at the door.
she is on her way, but she is not here now.
do we know she is on her way? she only said she would come.
then say: she said she would come, but she is not here now.
why is that more right?
it keeps to what you know. saying she would come does not tell you she has already left.
write a sentence about me reading with my brother. call me pico.
pico is reading with his brother.
i did not say his. use their.
pico is reading with their brother.
now make it about both of us reading our own books.
pico and their brother are each reading a book.
change it to yesterday.
pico and their brother each read a book yesterday.
can you say we instead of pico and their brother?
we each read a book yesterday.
i am home now. i went to the market this morning.
welcome back. did you find what you went there for?
yes. i bought apples and bread, and i met my aunt.
that gave you food for home and time to see your aunt. did you get to talk?
only a little. she was going to work.
a short hello can still be nice. you may have more time to talk when she is free.
please do not turn that into a thing i need to do.
okay. it can just be a nice part of your morning.
is it okay to say no when someone asks for my book? short answer.
yes. it is your book, and you can say no.
now give me a kind way to say it.
i am sorry, but i would like to keep this book with me today.
make it about tomorrow instead.
i am sorry, but i need this book tomorrow, so i cannot give it to you now.
do not say i need it. i only want to keep it.
i am sorry, but i would like to keep this book with me tomorrow too.
we plan to have tea at my house after our walk. now my friend can only walk a little.
you could take a short walk near your house, then come back for tea.
she would like to have tea and not go for a walk.
then you can meet at your house for tea and leave out the walk.
just give the new plan.
we can meet at my house for tea. we do not need to go for a walk.
did we change the place for tea?
no. tea is still at your house. only the walk changed.
write a talk where a teacher gives a student time to think.

teacher: why did the boy go back to the house? student: i need a little time to think. teacher: that is okay. look at the part where he leaves the park. student: he looks in his bag and cannot find his book. teacher: what does he do next? student: he goes back to the house to look for it. teacher: yes. you found the answer by reading that part again.
did the teacher just tell the student the answer?
no. the teacher helped the student look at the right part of the story.
can i say tomorrow i will visit my grandmother?
yes. that sentence is about a plan to visit your grandmother tomorrow.
can tomorrow go at the end?
yes. you can say: i will visit my grandmother tomorrow.
does it change who i will visit?
no. you will still visit your grandmother. you only changed where tomorrow goes in the sentence.
just give me the last sentence again.
i will visit my grandmother tomorrow.
my uncle helped me carry a box. write a thank you, but do not make it too much.
thank you for helping me carry the box. it was nice to have your help.
i could have moved it alone. can i still thank him?
yes. he still helped you. you can thank him for that, even if you could have done it on your own.
can you use easy in the note?
thank you for helping me carry the box. your help made it easy.
which one would you choose?
thank you for helping me carry the box. it was nice to have your help.
help me start a phone call to my grandfather. i have not called for a while.
you could say: hello, grandfather. it is nice to hear your voice. how have you been?
then what if he asks how i am?
answer with how you feel or a little about your day. for example: i am well. i went for a walk this morning and would like to hear about your day too.
i am tired, not well.
then you could say: i am a little tired today, but i am happy we can talk.
i like short books more than long books. should people only read short books?
no. people can choose what they like. you may enjoy a short book, and another person may enjoy a long one.
so both can be good?
you may enjoy short books more. another person may enjoy long books more. both can choose what they like.
so i do not have to read a long one to enjoy reading?
no. you can enjoy reading short books. the time you spend reading does not have to be long to be good.
write a story about someone making tomorrow morning easy by getting ready today.

a boy had to bring a book and a photo to school the next morning. after dinner, he found the book on his desk and put it in his bag. the photo was in a box on the shelf. he took it out and put it inside the book so it would not fall out of the bag. then he wrote a note to remember his coat. he put the note on his bag, where he would see it in the morning. his father asked if he was ready for school. the boy said almost. he put his shoes by the door, then came back to the table to have some water before bed.
where did he put the photo?
inside the book in his bag.
did he put the note in the book too?
no. he put the note on his bag.
my brother is not answering his phone. is he working or sleeping?
i do not know. he may be working or sleeping, or there may be another reason.
so it could be another thing too?
he may be working, sleeping, or doing another thing. not answering the phone does not tell us which.
he said he had work this afternoon.
then working may be a reason, but we still do not know for sure why he has not answered.
should i say he must be sleeping?
no. you do not know that. you could say he may be busy.
my mother put a cup under the table, then went outside. where is it?
the cup is under the table.
where is she?
your mother is outside.
she comes back and moves the cup to the shelf. where is it now?
the cup is on the shelf now.
is my mother still outside?
no. you said she came back and put the cup on the shelf.
do you know which room the shelf is in?
no. you have not said which room it is in.
give me a simple hello for someone opening this webpage.
hello. i am picoboi. what would you like to talk about?
make it more like a quiet friend.
hi. it is nice to have you here. what is on your mind?
add your name again.
hi. i am picoboi. we can talk about your day or work on a little writing together.
keep only hi and your name.
hi. i am picoboi.
how much will a new pen cost?
i would need to know which pen and shop you mean. do you know which pen you want to buy?
no. i just want a simple one for school.
you could ask the worker at the shop to show you a simple pen and tell you the price before you buy it.
give me what to say at the shop.
i am looking for a simple pen for school. could you show me one and tell me the price, please?
change can you close the window into a sentence saying what the person did.
you closed the window.
now say it about my sister.
my sister closed the window.
now say she has not done it.
my sister has not closed the window.
does that mean it is open?
not for sure. it only says your sister has not closed it. another person may have closed it.
so it could be open or closed?
yes. another person may have closed it, or it may still be open.
i had a hard time at work today.
i am sorry it was hard. would you like to talk about your day?
i kept getting asked to do more before i had finished the first thing.
that can feel like too much at once. you could ask which thing should come first.
i do not want a plan right now. i just want to talk.
okay. i can listen. you had more to do before you could finish what you had already started.
yes. i just need someone to understand that.
i understand what you are telling me. it felt like too much at once.
tell a story about a book someone leaves at a house and reads when they visit again.

a girl visited her grandmother and found a book on the table. they read the first part together before it was time for the girl to go home. she asked if she could take it with her. her grandmother said she could, but the girl chose to leave it there so they could read together next time. when she came back to the house, the book was still on the table, with a piece of paper at the page they would read next. her grandmother made tea, and the girl opened the book. they sat by the window and read the next part together.
did the girl finish the book on the first visit?
no. they read the first part and kept the rest for another visit.
why did she leave it there?
she chose to read it with her grandmother next time.
my plan is to wash my shirt, call my aunt, and read before bed. can you follow my list while we talk?
yes. in this talk, you said you plan to wash your shirt, call your aunt, and read before bed.
i washed the shirt already.
then calling your aunt and reading before bed are still on your list.
i called her too, but she did not answer.
you made the call. you can choose to try again later if you want. reading before bed is still on the list.
just tell me the one thing i have not started.
reading before bed.
write a note asking my sister to wait for me by the school door.
please wait for me by the school door.
add that i will come after i get my bag.
please wait for me by the school door. i will come after i get my bag.
now make it me waiting for her.
i will wait for you by the school door. please come after you get your bag.
i did not say she has to get a bag.
i will wait for you by the school door. please come when you are ready.
i am going to try reading my story to a friend tomorrow. will it go well?
i hope it goes well, but i cannot know how it will go. you could read it once on your own first if that helps you feel ready.
i already did that.
then you have already had some time with it. you can take your time when you read to your friend too.
do you know for sure they will like it?
no. i cannot know for sure how another person will feel. i can hope they enjoy hearing your story.
write about a room with a radio playing. do not say what song is on.
music comes from the radio on the shelf. there is a chair by the window and an open book on the table. a cup is next to the book. the room feels calm.
add a person sitting in the chair.
music comes from the radio on the shelf. a woman sits in the chair by the window. an open book and a cup are on the table. the room feels calm.
say what she does next.
she gets up to take her cup to the kitchen, then comes back to read her book.
ask me one easy question so we can talk.
do you like to read in the morning or in the evening?
in the evening, after the house gets quiet.
that can be a calm time to sit with a book. do you read by a window or in another place?
by my bed. there is no light outside then.
by your bed may be a nice place to read at the end of the day.
yes. i like that quiet time before sleep.
that can be a nice way to end your day.
my friend would like to meet tomorrow instead of today. i would like today, but tomorrow is okay.
you could say: i would like to see you today, but tomorrow works for me too.
could that sound like i do not want to wait?
it says you would like today, but it also says tomorrow is okay. you can just say tomorrow is okay if you do not want to talk about today.
give me the short answer about tomorrow.
tomorrow is okay with me. i am happy we will still get to see each other.
